title: Hospitality Management: Food and Beverage Fundamentals
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Hospitality Management: Food and Beverage Fundamentals - Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Students will demonstrate the ability to identify and mitigate risks related to foodborne illnesses, implement HACCP plans, and maintain safety and sanitation standards in compliance with industry regulations.
Students will design and evaluate menus that align with customer demographics, nutritional guidelines, and operational goals, while incorporating emerging industry trends.
Students will demonstrate proficiency in food and beverage purchasing, receiving, storage, and inventory management while applying cost control techniques and waste reduction strategies.
Students will apply effective communication and service delivery strategies to enhance guest experiences and ensure consistent service quality across diverse hospitality environments.
Students will analyze current trends and challenges in the food and beverage industry and articulate strategies for career advancement within the field.
